content: ONNX/ONNX Runtime explicitly does not guarantee bit-exact cross-backend output; the spec only requires numerical closeness within float tolerances. ONNX Backend Test suite and ORT optimization tests commonly use combined absolute+relative tolerance checks, e.g. atol=1e-7/rtol=1e-3 or atol=1e-3/rtol=1e-3, applied per-element to output tensors.
